prediction.likelyOutcome: LBJ Venture will very likely prevail on liability and on recovering a rent deficiency plus late fees, interest, and attorney's fees, but is unlikely to obtain the full $538,000 accelerated-rent judgment or the $300,000 kitchen award as framed — Section 10.02(b)'s text favors a periodic-deficiency remedy once the landlord relet, and the kitchen claim lacks any admissible valuation evidence. Expect a judgment closer to the tenant's deficiency computation (roughly $90,000-$100,000 in rent/fees/interest) plus a substantial, though possibly trimmed, attorney's fee award, well short of the landlord's ~$905,000 combined request.

issues.label: Landlord's Mitigation Efforts (Defense to Any Failure-to-Mitigate Argument)

outcome.description: After the bench trial the trial court rendered judgment for the landlord of $96,072.49 (unpaid rent through trial net of replacement-tenant rent, late fees, and prejudgment interest) — the figure the tenant advocated, roughly one-tenth of the more than $900,000 the landlord sought — plus 18% post-judgment interest, and awarded $0 in attorneys' fees. The court of appeals affirmed the damages award and reversed only the denial of attorneys' fees, remanding for a determination of a reasonable fee under the lease.
outcome.finalNote: Damages affirmed; fee denial reversed and remanded.
